messages:
maria: Morning team — quick swap: I'm on for the 07:00–15:00 PST window today. Leaving the watchlist updated below. Please ping if you take any long-running infra work.

kevin: noted, thanks. I'm on standby 15:00–23:00 PST. I'll take pager if anything spikes during the evening deploy.

sachin: no blockers from my side. FYI there's a small memory regression on model-serving-prod-2 we've been tracking — root cause looks like a KV cache leak when requests exceed 2k concurrent tokens. It's intermittent.

maria: thanks — adding to watchlist. Any mitigations in place?

sachin: set autoscaler cap temporarily to +1 replica for pool-prod-2, and enabled aggressive KV eviction for that pool. Logs: `service/model-server: evict-prefix: true` in the config.

jules: saw a spike overnight (01:12 UTC) similar pattern. Increased `max_inflight_tokens` on the node and it recovered. Will follow up with a small patch to reset per-session cache after 5 min idle.

maria: action item — jules, can you open a tiny PR for the cache-reset? Mark it as urgent but small, we can ship canary.

jules: will do, target PR in the next 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Canary started: rollout/model-server@v3.4.1 -> pool-prod-2 (10% traffic) :rocket:

maria: Canary noted. Keep an eye on latency p50/p95. If p95 > 600ms for 5m, abort.

kevin: I'll watch latency during my shift. If canary triggers, who's primary to roll back? @sachin or @maria?

sachin: I'll be reachable for rollback during the morning. Kevin, you'll have rights to trigger abort too.

maria: watchlist snapshot (copy-paste):
- model-serving-prod-2: intermittent memory growth (mitigated by eviction) :rotating_light:
- canary/model-server v3.4.1 — monitor p50/p95 and error-rate :eyes:
- redis-cache-a — high connection churn (observed, but under threshold)
- billing-alerts — muted today for a billing job at 09:00 UTC (expected)

kevin: added personal note — I'm handling the scheduled dataset-run at 18:00 PST; if it overlaps with canary abort, I'll hand off immediately.

maria: quick checklist for incoming oncall:
1) Check Grafana dashboard: `infra-prod/model-server-overview`
2) Inspect canary metrics: `model-server/canary/v3.4.1`
3) If memory leak recurs, run temporary eviction: `kubectl exec -n prod svc/model-server -- ./evict-kv --pool pool-prod-2`
4) Pager policy: pager fires for SLO breaches (latency p95 > 750ms for 10m) and OOMs
5) Contact list: @sachin -> infra, @jules -> runtime, @kevin -> deploys

sachin: adding note — there is a dev environment test you can run locally to repro the leak: `./tools/run_leak_repro.sh --pool=prod-2 --duration=5m`

jules: PR opened: `fix/kv-reset-ttl` (#2147). It resets per-session KV after 5m idle and adds metrics `kv.reset_count`. Links: https://git.internal/r/2147

maria: thanks. I'll queue a canary rollout of the patch after current canary finishes if metrics look good.

kevin: small FYI — I'm switching my pager hours tomorrow earlier (start 14:00 PST) so coverage will be slightly shifted. Updated rota in the calendar.

maria: noted — I'll update the oncall rota doc and slack #eng-oncall pinned message.

oncall-bot: Reminder — daily shift handover check-in due by 07:10 PST.

maria: final: if you see sustained error-rate bump > 0.5% for 15m, escalate to paging and post logs snippet here. Example quick command:
```
# tail last 200 error lines from model server
kubectl logs -n prod svc/model-server -c runtime --tail=200 | grep ERROR | tail -n 200
```

kevin: will do. I'll ping here when I take over at 15:00 PST.

sachin: thanks all — keeping eyes on pool-prod-2. Will post if I replicate the leak locally.

jules: I'll monitor canary logs and metrics, and merge the PR if green.

maria: great. Handing off now — please ACK when you read. :white_check_mark:

kevin: ACK.

sachin: ACK.

jules: ACK and watching canary.

maria: end of thread.
